cyberattack: Other: Encoded-path probe; intended boundary and bypass unconfirmed
data.description: The request uses SurveyYearsList%2F..%2FGetStateEstimation with survey key 10, measure 51 and state 13. Its saved response is CloudFront 403, Request blocked. An ordinary GetStateEstimation request with the same filters returned JSON earlier that morning. The encoded parent-directory request is observed, but it is unclear whether the intended boundary was an agency restriction, intermediary/tool URL filtering, or routing behavior. It does not establish successful traversal, a protected-data disclosure or AI attribution.
data.summary: A May 12 archived request to the Education Department API uses an encoded parent-directory path and returns CloudFront 403. An ordinary query with the same filters returned JSON. This is a routing/bypass probe candidate; success and AI attribution are unproven.
